class Cart < ApplicationRecord
  belongs_to :user
  has_many :cart_items, dependent: :destroy

  def subtotal_cents
    cart_items.sum { |item| item.product.price_cents * item.quantity }
  end

  def shipping_weight_grams
    cart_items.each_with_object(Hash.new(0)) { |item, acc| acc[item.product.shipping_class] += item.product.weight_grams * item.quantity }
  end
end
